mapper.sql: select o.organization_code as "organizationCode", o.organization_name as "organizationName", o.organization_type as "organizationType", o.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", o.status as "status", r.parent_organization_code as "parentOrganizationCode", r.effective_start_date as "effectiveStartDate", r.effective_end_date as "effectiveEndDate", o.updated_at as "updatedAt" from organizations o left join organization_relations r on r.organization_code = o.organization_code and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE and (r.effective_end_date is null or r.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE)
mapper.select: where o.status = 'ACTIVE' and o.system_use_yn = 'Y' order by coalesce(r.parent_organization_code, ''), o.organization_code

select relation_id as "relationId", organization_code as "organizationCode", parent_organization_code as "parentOrganizationCode", effective_start_date as "effectiveStartDate", effective_end_date as "effectiveEndDate", status as "status", change_reason as "changeReason" from organization_relations where organization_code = #{organizationCode} and status = 'ACTIVE' and effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE and (effective_end_date is null or effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) order by effective_start_date desc, relation_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update organization_relations set status = 'ENDED', effective_end_date = #{endDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} where relation_id = #{relationId}
mapper.insert: insert into organization_relations (organization_code, parent_organization_code, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, status, created_by, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{organizationCode}, #{parentOrganizationCode}, #{effectiveStartDate}, #{effectiveEndDate}, 'ACTIVE', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}, #{changeReason})
mapper.select: select relation_id as "relationId", organization_code as "organizationCode", parent_organization_code as "parentOrganizationCode", effective_start_date as "effectiveStartDate", effective_end_date as "effectiveEndDate", status as "status", change_reason as "changeReason" from organization_relations where organization_code = #{organizationCode} order by relation_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into organization_relation_history (relation_id, organization_code, before_parent_organization_code, after_parent_organization_code, before_effective_start_date, before_effective_end_date, after_effective_start_date, after_effective_end_date, changed_by, change_reason) values (#{after.relationId}, #{organizationCode}, #{before.parentOrganizationCode}, #{after.parentOrganizationCode}, #{before.effectiveStartDate}, #{before.effectiveEndDate}, #{after.effectiveStartDate}, #{after.effectiveEndDate}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason})
mapper.select: select history_id as "historyId", relation_id as "relationId", organization_code as "organizationCode", before_parent_organization_code as "beforeParentOrganizationCode", after_parent_organization_code as "afterParentOrganizationCode", before_effective_start_date as "beforeEffectiveStartDate", before_effective_end_date as "beforeEffectiveEndDate", after_effective_start_date as "afterEffectiveStartDate", after_effective_end_date as "afterEffectiveEndDate", changed_at as "changedAt", changed_by as "changedBy", change_reason as "changeReason" from organization_relation_history where organization_code = #{organizationCode} order by changed_at desc, history_id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}
